title: Paste the Stack Trace, Get the Fix from AI in Seconds
description:
Stop describing your crash to AI. Paste the stack trace instead! 🐛

✅ Run your code and copy the whole stack trace
✅ Paste it into your prompt with Fix this crash
✅ See how the line number points AI straight at the bug

Day 1 of AI Debugging. Next up: Day 2, Make AI Reproduce the Bug First.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to build with AI the right way.

#shorts #ai #aicoding #coding #programming #debugging #csharp
comment: Whole trace or just the error line: which do you paste? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: the line number in the trace (Program.cs:line 3) tells AI exactly where the crash happened, so keep it in your prompt.
